description: This file defines authentication-related routes for a web application including user registration, login, and profile retrieval. It handles user creation, credential verification, token issuance, and real-time activity emission.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, hash password, create user record, log activity, emit real-time event, and respond with JWT and user info.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Endpoint for user login, verifying credentials, creating activity log, emitting event, and responding with JWT and user info.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve current authenticated user's profile information.
